front: SOHCAHTOA — what does each part stand for?
back: Sin = Opposite/Hypotenuse, Cos = Adjacent/Hypotenuse, Tan = Opposite/Adjacent.

front: Are SOHCAHTOA and the sine/cosine rules given in the GCSE exam?
back: Yes — all of them are on the AQA formula sheet.

front: When do you use the sine rule?
back: When you know a side and its opposite angle, plus one more side or angle.

front: When do you use the cosine rule?
back: When you know all three sides, or two sides and the angle between them.

front: Area of a triangle using trigonometry
back: $\text{Area} = \dfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C$ — use when you know two sides and the angle between them.
